title: Line coverage 58.2% — several error branches untested
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.582; main_test.go exercises the happy paths and one 400 validation case but never hits get-by-missing-id 404 (main.go:133), the invalid-id 400 branch (main.go:127/147/179), or the DB-error 500 branches (main.go:84,105,162,185)
suggestion: Add tests for GET /books/{id} on a missing id (404) and a non-numeric id (400) to cover the error tail

title: Health endpoint returns plain text "OK" instead of JSON
evidence: main.go:67-70 healthHandler writes []byte("OK") with no Content-Type; other routes return JSON. R10 only requires a healthy status, so this passes, but it is inconsistent with the JSON contract in R8
suggestion: Return {"status":"ok"} with Content-Type application/json for consistency

title: Tests rebuild the route table instead of sharing main()'s wiring
evidence: main_test.go:27 newTestRouter duplicates the six route registrations from main.go:37-45 rather than calling a shared constructor, so route wiring drift would not be caught
suggestion: Extract route registration into a newRouter() helper called by both main() and the tests
